name: blazor-dev
description: Blazor/.NET agents (architect, developer, conductor, presales, triage, audit) + TDD subagents, skills, and workflows for full-lifecycle Blazor web-app development with HITL gates, modeled on the DynaHR reference architecture (Blazor WASM hosted, MudBlazor, Azure Functions, SQL Server via stored procedures, Azure AD B2C, multi-tenant SaaS).
